mapper.select: SELECT version FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE success = true AND version IS NOT NULL ORDER BY installed_rank DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM users) AS users_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM source) AS source_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM document) AS document_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM embedding_chunk) AS embedding_chunk_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM ingest_run) AS ingest_run_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM ugc_post) AS ugc_post_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM admin_job) AS admin_job_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM admin_audit_log) AS admin_audit_log_count
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database() AND state = 'active'
SELECT id, source_id, status, error_code, finished_at FROM ingest_run WHERE status IN ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS') ORDER BY COALESCE(finished_at, started_at) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT id, file_object_key FROM document WHERE document_status = 'ACTIVE' AND file_object_key IS NOT NULL AND btrim(file_object_key) <> '' ORDER BY id
SELECT d.id FROM document d WHERE d.document_status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM embedding_chunk ec WHERE ec.doc_ref_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND ec.doc_ref_id = d.id ) ORDER BY d.id

SELECT DISTINCT ec.doc_ref_type, ec.doc_ref_id FROM embedding_chunk ec WHERE ( ec.doc_ref_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM document d WHERE d.id = ec.doc_ref_id ) ) OR ( ec.doc_ref_type = 'UGC' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ugc_post p WHERE p.id = ec.doc_ref_id ) ) ORDER BY ec.doc_ref_type, ec.doc_ref_id
SELECT file_object_key FROM document WHERE file_object_key IS NOT NULL AND btrim(file_object_key) <> ''
SELECT id FROM ingest_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND heartbeat_at < now() - CAST(#{timeout,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS interval) ORDER BY id
